name: KimiKiss Chotto Matome Gekijou
original_name: キミキス ちょっとまとめ劇場
source:
A collection of nine scenarios with main heroines of KimiKiss and also additional heroines never appearing in KimiKiss. There is also an anniversary parody story and a drama CD.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
九个场景的集合，其中包括《KimiKiss》的主要女主角以及从未在《KimiKiss》中出现的其他女主角。还有一个周年纪念模仿故事和一张戏剧CD。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-february-2008-switch-boku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
